DEV.strongest_supportable_claim: DEV is a development/calibration pool. It can support future development, resampling or model-selection roles only under a newly frozen protocol, but it cannot support an independent final-generalization claim.

VALIDATION.strongest_supportable_claim: Historical VALIDATION results remain useful descriptive evidence about past candidates, but the split is not an independent holdout for current/future candidate, policy, runtime, provider or architecture generalization claims because its outcomes repeatedly informed downstream development. The extent of additional row-level exposure is unknown and not needed for this conclusion.

LOCKED_TEST.human_raw_semantic_oracle_exposure: NO_EVIDENCE; broader operator-local history remains bounded UNKNOWN
LOCKED_TEST.strongest_supportable_claim: No committed evidence establishes candidate execution or task-quality feedback on LOCKED_TEST, but the split is not pristine/untouched for the full evaluation stack because private structural alignment information from all 3 locked groups was used to change evaluator-v4 alignment. Whether the split can still serve any final-holdout role is deliberately deferred to BIG-B2.
